Week 36 | Tuesday 08th September 2026
Market Insight
By Nikos Tagoulis, Senior Analyst
Last week brought a series of developments aimed at strength-
ening of Venezuela 's oil sector. The US administration announced
an agreement granting the US North American Blue Energy Part-
ners (NABEP), up to 100 -year concessions over 17 Venezuelan oil
fields with estimated reserves of 65 bn barrels, equivalent to
roughly 20% of the country 's total. Under the agreement, NABEP
has given the US government a 35% stake and the right to pur-
chase 20% of production from current and future fields.
